decision: Keep as the current statically validated bare-model candidate. It reduces only the supplemental curve-brake envelope while a recognized obstacle or miss latch remains bound to the existing target30 compound state. It does not establish a lap-time, clearance, completion, submission or SOTA improvement without an authorized paired driving evaluation.

video_evidence.attribution: user-attributed submission11 replay videos without source/model/package receipt binding

submission7_comparison.causality_limit: Intermediate candidate changes and missing package receipts prevent attribution to one factor.

obstacle_speed_proxy.method: background-motion-corrected Lucas-Kanade video optical flow around HSV-detected vehicle/obstacle closest approaches
obstacle_speed_proxy.interpretation: The user's localized over-braking feedback is directionally supported, but this is a relative rendered-video proxy rather than physical speed or action telemetry.

minimum_rendered_center_distance_pixels.limitation: Screen-center distance is not vehicle-body clearance.

implementation: Route only bare state-dict inference through _CompoundObstacleBrakeCarryController; explicit export, DrQ and HAIC paths remain unchanged.
Refactor the existing HighSpeed supplemental curve-brake computation behind an algebraically identical hook.
Qualify only when the current command and pace-latched targets are both exactly30 and a current obstacle side or frame-start miss latch is active.
Replace supplemental clip(0.06 + 0.018*excess,0.06,0.28) with clip(0.04 + 0.012*excess,0.04,0.18), where excess=speed-target-0.5.
Take max with the inherited base brake before the unchanged final nextafter(float32(0.28),0) clamp.
Keep target30, detector, obstacle side, four-frame latch, fifth-frame release, steering, gas, recovery, clear-straight double throttle and every noncompound state unchanged.
Add no mutable candidate state and no seed, track, coordinate, progress or time condition.

residual_risks: Rendered video does not expose the internal84x84 policy observation, sweep, estimated speed or emitted actions, so it cannot prove which visual obstacles entered the new gate.
At target30 and speed40 the candidate emits0.154 rather than0.231 brake; future closed-loop trajectory and clearance can change even though target, steering and base brake remain fixed.
The closest Track2 encounter appears visually straight and likely noncompound, but the rendered replay cannot prove the internal sweep remained below6.
Same-input static tests cannot establish completion, collision/off-track non-regression or lap-time improvement.
SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf remain absent, so environment evaluation, promotion and submission remain blocked.
